style: Rich hand-painted storybook illustration, soft painterly brushwork, luminous, warm, cinematic, the same hand as the app's player-card backgrounds. A game's cover painting: one clear subject in the upper-middle of the frame, readable at thumbnail size. The lower third is calm, simple and darker so a white title can sit on it. No frame, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no faces, no hands.
